OPML Import / Export

Export

Download your subscriptions and settings as an OPML file. Compatible with Tiny Tiny RSS and most other RSS readers. Leave only Feeds & folders ticked for a plain OPML file with nothing but your subscriptions.

Import

Import feeds and settings from an OPML file. Existing feeds and labels with the same URL / name are skipped. Max file size: 1 MB.
Import is best-effort - each section is saved independently, so partial results are kept if a later section fails.
